name: ATMA: Web Browser
subtitle: Websites, tabs and shortcuts
promotionalText: Browse websites, save shortcuts and organize them into folders. No ATMA account or in-app purchases required.
description:
ATMA is a browser for iPhone and iPad that helps you organize websites and return to the pages you use.

YOUR WEBSITES, TOGETHER
Save shortcuts with website icons on the ATMA start page, organize them into folders and choose your appearance. Open saved websites again with one tap.

TABS AND SEARCH
Enter addresses, choose a search engine and switch between tabs. Page snapshots are available for ordinary tabs.

MORE ROOM FOR THE PAGE
Open saved websites with a compact bottom toolbar. Back, forward, address, reload and the ATMA home button remain within reach.

INCOGNITO
Open temporary private tabs from Settings. In Incognito you can choose a User-Agent and mobile or desktop website mode. Their website data is separate from ordinary sign-ins, and the tabs are not restored after restarting ATMA. Ending the private session discards its temporary website data. Files and shortcuts you deliberately save remain. Incognito does not hide your IP address or signed-in account from websites.

CONTROL LOCAL DATA
Inspect websites, local data types and cookies without secret values; delete website data, manage ordinary downloads and keep selected links on a PIN-protected page. The PIN protects that page of links; it does not make website visits anonymous. Sign-in persistence depends on cookies and the website rules.

MEDIA CONTROLS
Control compatible video and audio. Picture in Picture and background playback depend on the website, the media and iOS.

ATMA is free, with no in-app purchases or ATMA subscriptions. No ATMA account is needed. Websites you open may offer their own paid services under their own terms.

Ordinary tabs use system WebKit on the current iPhone or iPad. An Incognito User-Agent choice does not change the device. Built-in filtering limits known advertising requests; results vary by website.
